digest.component_or_area: plan-review verdict dispatch and criteria assembly
propositions: CriteriaError during criteria assembly is incorrectly classified as llm_unavailable=true even when no LLM call executed, causing operators to investigate provider credentials instead of configuration mismatch
The workflow recorder preserves only undifferentiated exception strings, losing typed failure identity that would distinguish criteria config faults from genuine LLM outages

A config-fault verdict must emit INDETERMINATE with deterministic coverage and a distinct config_fault field, omitting the affirmative llm_unavailable label, and name the installed rebar build as suspect with guidance to use the repository checkout build
Genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider paths must remain byte-for-byte unchanged after routing config faults through a dedicated verdict path
Deterministic blockers must produce BLOCK rather than being masked by a config-fault INDETERMINATE
